title: Why Your Brain Will Never Feel Rich — The $500K Trap
hook: No matter how much more you earn, you adapt and want more — and scientists just proved this loop never stops.
angle: Hedonic adaptation is measurable: a Wharton study of 33,000 adults found a happiness plateau, and surveys show people always need 40% more than they earn to feel 'comfortable' — regardless of income level.
audience: High earners frustrated that more money hasn't made them happier, and anyone chasing an 'enough' number that keeps moving.
key_numbers: 40% — how much more income people always think they need to feel comfortable
$500,000 — where happiness gains near zero in the Wharton study
1 year — how fast your brain resets after any financial upgrade
